neighbours.label: harsh criticism: the opening ' sc' of ' sc'+'olded', ' sc'+'olding', ' sc'+'athing', and ' said' before 'sharply', firing there; praise and gentle words in the same frames stay low
fire: The boy looked down as if he was being scolded by his aunt.
You miss your bus, you are late, and you get scolded for it.
The reviewer could be scathing in her columns on opera.
Nobody likes being scolded in front of the whole class.
Her father gave her a sharp scolding for lying.
The report was scathing about the state of the prisons.
“Stop that at once,” the nurse said sharply.
The teacher scolded the pupils for talking.
quiet: The boy looked down as if he was being fed by his aunt.
You catch your bus, you are early, and you get thanked for it.
The reviewer could be generous in her columns on opera.
Nobody likes being cold in front of the whole class.
Her father gave her a warm hug for trying.
The report was brief about the state of the prisons.
“Have another one,” the nurse said softly.
The teacher praised the pupils for listening.
